python_baseline.python_changes: none; Python remains the reference implementation and conformance driver

desktop.layout: rust/crates/repopact-desktop-api plus rust/apps/repopact-desktop/{src,src-tauri}; reusable governance crates remain Tauri-free.
desktop.frontend_authority: No frontend fs/shell/process/remote-origin/arbitrary-path authority. tauri-plugin-fs is only a transitive Rust dependency of the dialog plugin and is not initialized or capability-authorized for the webview.

dto_generation.result: passed; lifecycle values and DTO wire shapes are generated from Rust source

session_and_plans.session: One native active repository; session-N generation/id; switch tears down watcher and clears plans; stale session ids reject commands.
session_and_plans.registry: Bounded in-memory registry of 32 opaque plan handles; stored entry retains the original Rust MutationPlan, session binding, and MutationPlanView.
session_and_plans.apply: apply_mutation_plan accepts session id plus opaque handle only, rechecks WI054 content-addressed read-set preconditions, consumes successful/terminal handles, and never accepts frontend file operations or a round-tripped raw plan.
session_and_plans.persistence: No repository-local transaction database, hidden journal, or persistent plan state.

watcher.behavior: Recursive normalized repository-relative paths, ignored-directory filtering, access-event filtering, 120ms debounce/coalescing, bounded full snapshot refresh, typed event polling/emission, external/self-apply origin classification, and session shutdown/switch cleanup.
watcher.result: External refresh and self-apply convergence passed in desktop smoke; invalid external state remains observable through refreshed validation diagnostics.

ui.delivered: Dashboard/health, Work browse/detail/filter/search, guided three-step create, typed edit/transition plan review, Decisions read-only browse/detail, Evidence read-only browse/detail, Graph table, Validation, Analysis, Settings, theme and accessibility states.
ui.native_smoke: Windows release app launched; native folder picker selected the scratch repository; Dashboard, Work, Decisions, and Settings views were observed with live watcher status and repository-change toast.
ui.boundaries: React owns presentation/form state only; it does not parse canonical files, implement governance rules, expose evidence_plan, or hold executable mutation authority.

e2e.operations: Rust desktop boundary smoke covered open, browse/read derivation, validation, analysis, graph, typed create/edit/transition plan-preview-apply, external refresh, stale-plan rejection after consumed-input drift, and stale-session rejection after repository switch.
e2e.final_validation: Python and Rust validators both passed on the final scratch state; development repository was not used as an uncontrolled mutation fixture.
e2e.visual_automation_note: The configured desktop UI automation helper could not initialize on this host because its kernel asset path was unavailable (os error 3); native launch/folder selection/view navigation were additionally exercised with the Windows window and keyboard path.
